featuredRaces.title: The Merriest Night
featuredRaces.description: A festive evening of running and holiday celebration, featuring a 5K Run, Mile Walk/Run, and Daisy’s Reindeer Run. Register before December 1 for free race swag at packet pickup. Enjoy complimentary cocoa, holiday music, crafts, food, North Pole Main Street, and more.

pricing.intro: Choose a package or build a custom combination of services for your event.

packages.name: On The Penny
features: Official live results and age-group/team scoring

packages.name: On The Nickel
features: Basic awards for top five male and female finishers

packages.name: On The Dime
features: Basic awards for seven age groups and overall finishers
Awards ceremony available 15 minutes after last finisher
Email and social media marketing assistance

packages.name: On The Quarter
packages.capacity: Up to 250 registrants; $2 per additional entry
features: Staff-led course via bicycle or host-provided 4×4
Race-branded finish tape for first male/female finishers
Two basic trophies for top male and female finishers

extras.name: Event merchandise
extras.detail: Through The Corner Press; minimum order 30.

extras.detail: Event name engraving; fully custom medals available by arrangement.

extras.name: Premium finish
extras.detail: 13-foot inflatable finish arch. Other banners, signs and finish-line options available.
